column2: Allow the selected devices to work on Shop Expansion's shelves and in the back room.
Water Expanded works on the shelves

Water Expanded's faucet, pipes, bottler and bridge only work in the shop's own grid. With this on they also work on Shop Expansion's shelves, also inside a Machine Bay that stands on a shelf. Does nothing unless both mods are running.
Water Expanded works in the back room
Allow Water Expanded's devices to work in the back room, also inside containers. Needs only Water Expanded.
